arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
ENVFILE="$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"
WARM="$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh"
KEEP="$BASE/bin/ollama-keepalive"
LOCK="$BASE/.ollama-keepalive/ensure-v2.lock"
WARM_PATH="$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh"

env_count="$(grep -c '^export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1$' "$ENVFILE" || true)"
[ "$env_count" = "1" ] || { echo "CAS_ABORT env_minus1_count=$env_count"; exit 20; }

cron_before="$(mktemp)"
crontab -l >"$cron_before"
warm_count="$(grep -F -c "$WARM_PATH" "$cron_before" || true)"
[ "$warm_count" = "2" ] || { echo "CAS_ABORT warm_cron_count=$warm_count"; rm -f "$cron_before"; exit 21; }

ts="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
BDIR="$BASE/backups/ollama-finite-residency-$ts"
mkdir -p "$BDIR"; chmod 700 "$BDIR"
cp -p "$ENVFILE" "$BDIR/ollama-runtime.env.before"
cp -p "$cron_before" "$BDIR/crontab.before"
cp -p "$WARM" "$BDIR/warm-residency.sh.before"
chmod 600 "$BDIR/crontab.before" 2>/dev/null || true

env_tmp="$(mktemp "$BASE/.ollama-runtime.env.XXXXXX")"
sed 's/^export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1$/export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m/' "$ENVFILE" >"$env_tmp"
chmod 600 "$env_tmp"
mv "$env_tmp" "$ENVFILE"

cron_after="$(mktemp)"
grep -Fv "$WARM_PATH" "$cron_before" >"$cron_after" || true
crontab "$cron_after"
rm -f "$cron_after" "$cron_before"

echo "ROLLBACK_DIR=$BDIR"
echo '--- CONFIG_AFTER ---'
grep -n -E '^export OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|CONTEXT_LENGTH|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL)=' "$ENVFILE"
echo '--- WARM_CRON_AFTER ---'
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -F "$WARM_PATH" || true

mkdir -p "$BASE/.ollama-keepalive"
exec 8>"$LOCK"
flock -x 8
pid="$(pgrep -f "^$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama serve$" | head -n1 || true)"
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
  echo "OLD_PID=$pid"
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  i=0
  while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
  if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo "STOP_TIMEOUT=$pid"; exit 22; fi
fi
rm -f "$BASE/ollama-runtime.pid"
flock -u 8

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 3 ]; do
  "$KEEP" ensure && break
  rc=$?
  [ "$rc" = "75" ] || exit "$rc"
  sleep 2
  i=$((i+1))
done

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
  i=$((i+1))
done
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null

newpid="$(pgrep -f "^$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama serve$" | head -n1 || true)"
[ -n "$newpid" ] || { echo NO_NEW_PID; exit 23; }
echo "NEW_PID=$newpid"
echo '--- EFFECTIVE_ENV ---'
tr '\0' '\n' <"/proc/$newpid/environ" | grep -E '^OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|CONTEXT_LENGTH|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL|NUM_THREAD)=' | sort
echo '--- API_PS ---'
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps; echo
echo '--- KEEPALIVE_STATUS ---'
"$KEEP" status
